ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across the primary surface area with localized high-intensity (white) punctate regions; extreme contrast ratio relative to the high-intensity background water surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-pixel region across both lobes; distinct high-intensity white clusters (mottling/scars) concentrated on the left distal tip, the lower central fluke near the water line, and the far-right distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated aperture of approximately 105 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 1/6th of the visible vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left trailing edge contains 6 distinct peaks with pixel-amplitudes varying between 12-25 pixels; right trailing edge displays a more irregular, high-frequency serrated profile with a significant indentation midway between notch and tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a strong concave curvature sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips; leading edges (visible on left) show a convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular high-contrast white pixels on the distal edges of both lobes, specifically at the far-left apex and along the jagged right-side tip area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple low-intensity gray linear streaks (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the mid-section of the right lobe and horizontally across the lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white circular scarring indicative of barnacle attachment sites across the peripheral boundaries; visible linear rake marks; irregular, jagged trailing edge on the right lobe suggesting historic physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme pixel jaggedness and high-intensity cluster concentration on the rightmost distal tip compared to the relatively smoother curvature of the left lobe.
